note: Recipes for the shared stock b-roll / stills library (media/library/broll/). SOURCE OF TRUTH for what the library should contain: one entry per reusable, generically-named b-roll need. tools/fetch_stock.py reads this for the --palette quick-picks and documents fetched hits in catalog.json. Organized by the visual job they serve on the three tracks: mood/atmosphere (rain, fog, city), subject cutaways (coffee, paper, hands), and documentary stills (Commons, public-domain/CC only). Brand taste: calm/premium (Linear/Anthropic/Vercel) — soft, understated, vertical-friendly, no loud stock clichés. Every entry maps to a suggested Pexels/Pixabay/Commons query; the actual fetched files live in catalog.json.

palette.usage: establishing mood / transition underlay on moody shorts
soft, premium background bed for vox/explainer segments
establishing city shots for tech/business shorts
tactile cutaway for craft/handmade/vox paper-collage context
generic 'person working' cutaway for coding/tech shorts
public-domain/CC documentary stills for vox documentary tracks (Commons)
